title: PlanRequest
description: One planner request (06 §2). v1 carries the song document because the server holds no projects (docs/wp/2.6.md); the API never stores it.

doc.description: The `Project` at the commit the user is looking at. Analyses travel inside it.

prompt.description: The user's words. Untrusted: escaped and placed in a data block before it reaches the model.

region.description: The lasso / selection the prompt targets. Absent for song chat.

explain.description: Ask for an `Explanation` instead of an `EditPlan` (06 §8).

libraryNames.description: Artist and title strings from the user's library, for the content-policy pre-pass (10 §7).

sectionFeatures.description: Per-section analysis the client already has (energy, chords, active stems), because `bragi-model` never reads analysis blobs (docs/wp/2.6.md, deviation A). Optional: an older client still gets a usable summary.

PlannerUiContext.description: What the user is looking at (06 §2).

PlannerView.description: Which view the prompt bar is open in (06 §2).

LibraryName.description: One artist or title string to block (10 §7).

SectionFeatures.description: One section's compact analysis features. Values come from the analysis view, never from the model.

energy.description: Mean short-term energy over the section, 0..1.

chords.description: Chord symbols heard in the section, in time order.

activeStems.description: Track ids that carry audio in the section.
